_note: D64 (2026-10-26). Free AI presentation generators the browser agent may use, ranked, with what each vendor's OWN pages said on 2026-10-26 (quoted, with the page and the date it was read). Memory, search snippets and AI summaries were leads only. status: shortlist (tried first, in rank order), fallback (tried after the shortlist), excluded (never tried: the reason is given), unverified (a vendor page could not be read, so nothing is claimed). terms_class: clean (the terms read today have no clause on automated access), scraping_clause (the terms bar bots / scrapers / crawlers or 'automated software' from pages; one deck for the owner, in his own session, at human pace, is not scraping, but the clause is broad; the grant card shows it to the owner and he decides with his PIN), ordinary_use_clause (tools that act 'contrary to the ordinary use' are barred), forbids (excluded). Ranking rule: terms first, then a free export of a usable file, then free credits. Rank, free limits and UI change: re-read the pages before relying on this file after a month. Protected from agent pushes (push_gate).

sites.name: Gamma
sites.free: 'Each new Free user receives 400 credits when initially signing up.' 'On the Free plan, all AI actions use credits, and credits do not refresh.' 'Generating presentations with Create with AI uses credits, metered per slide and per image.' (help.gamma.app article 7834324, 2026-10-26) Second vendor page, same day: 'Every new account starts on the Free Plan with no time limit and no credit card required, and comes with 400 credits' and 'Generate up to 10 slides in a single prompt' (help.gamma.app article 8077107, 'Updated over 3 weeks ago'). The scout sweep of the same day did not find the 400 figure on that page; both vendor pages say it, so it is settled for now: re-read before relying on it.
sites.exports: PDF, PNG, PowerPoint (PPTX), Google Slides via PPTX upload; Share > Export (help.gamma.app article 8022861). On the Free plan: 'The Made by Gamma badge appears on PDF and PPTX exports when your workspace is on the Free plan at the time of export'.
sites.terms_quote: Terms of Use, 'Effective Date: September 9, 2025': 'you shall not use any manual or automated software, devices or other processes (including but not limited to spiders, robots, scrapers, crawlers, avatars, data mining tools or the like) to "scrape" or download data from any web pages contained in the Site' and, among the grounds for termination, 'using manual or automated software or other means to access, "scrape," "crawl" or "spider" any pages contained in Services'. (gamma.app terms, read through production-vercel-app.gamma.app/terms because gamma.app itself answered a Cloudflare challenge, 2026-10-26)
sites.signin: not read on the sign-in page (gamma.app is behind a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge for a non-browser client); the owner's real Chrome normally passes it silently. If a CAPTCHA shows, the agent stops and asks.
sites.captcha: gamma.app returned HTTP 403 'Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue' to this server's fetch on 2026-10-26: a bot check exists. In the owner's signed-in Chrome it may not show; if it does the agent stops (never solves it).
sites.notes: SANCTIONED AUTOMATION EXISTS: 'API keys are available on all plans, including Free; usage is limited by your credits' and 'The MCP server and the ChatGPT, Claude, and Slack connectors work on all plans.' (developers.gamma.app/get-started/access-and-pricing, 2026-10-26). If the owner prefers the terms-clean route for Gamma, a later grant can add an API-key flow (a design hook; not built here). Best generator of the three; the badge stays on Free exports.

api_route.note: Gamma's own developer page (developers.gamma.app/get-started/access-and-pricing, 2026-10-26): 'API keys are available on all plans, including Free'; MCP and the ChatGPT, Claude and Slack connectors work on all plans; Free = at most 10 cards per gamma, 2 agent jobs in flight; generations cost credits. A generation by API needs no sign-in UI and no automation clause (the scout sweep, jarvis/scout/findings/2026-10-26.md item 3, ranks it first). It is NOT built here: the owner must create the key himself (kept in D:\jarvis-secrets, never read by an agent) and read Gamma's API terms first (the terms page answered HTTP 403 to the scout's fetch and Cloudflare to ours). The UI route in this file stays the fallback, and when the API route exists it goes in front of it.
